title: Rose Hearts Quilting Embroidery Design
author: DigitEMB
description:
Two Hearts and Roses Arrangement embroidery design is a delicate and detailed embroidery that has a beautiful combination of simple lines and detailed floral embroidery. It will look lovely stitched out onto napkins, wedding t-shirts, or your valentine’s day crafts.
This machine embroidery design comes with multiple embroidery file formats and can be used in multiple embroidery machines.
